method: Literal mechanical extraction from comment-masked TeX; no image/context access or interpretation of meanings.
limitations: Dot-terminated tokens include sentence-final words and other false candidates.
Single and spaced multi-token candidates may overlap and are not additive counts.
TeX source lines are not physical manuscript line numbers.
Identical macro spelling is counted literally; no equivalence between alphabets, letters or readings is inferred.
Occurrences in deleted, inserted, doubtful and marginal content are retained together and remain locatable in the source.
